propositions: Core transport/construction sites (applier, fetcher, run_differs, _attestation) currently construct AcliClient inline and import Jira vendor mappers directly, coupling the backend-neutral core to a concrete vendor implementation

The four transport-construction sites and provider-identity literals must be routed through the Backend port abstraction so the core obtains transport via select_backend().transport rather than constructing it inline

Core importer sites (outbound_differ, inbound_differ, apply_inbound, outbound_comments, inbound_translate) currently import vendor field mappers directly and must be refactored to receive them via dependency injection
ADF-sizing constants, lossy-status value-maps, and outbound_links relation constants are currently scattered across the codebase and must be single-sourced under adapters/jira/
